candidate_prefix_tail.interpretation: Exact shared token-ID prefix within the same input/candidate pair only. Remaining tails have no asserted semantic or positional alignment. Saved prefix probability residuals are retained, not set to zero; their computational source has not been isolated.

definitions.b0_interpretation: Average of four contextual cue-bearing scores, not a context-free language prior.
definitions.threshold_interpretation: Both absolute t values must reach the threshold; zero is a tie, never a strict sign flip.
definitions.units: natural-log sequence-probability differences; no length normalization

denominators.note: Unique scientific cell identities across three acquisitions, not independent observations; repeated candidates and engineering parity do not increase the 24-scenario sample.

energy_share_interpretation: Algebraic squared score-change shares; not causal explained fractions or population variance attribution.
leave_one_family_out_interpretation: All six omissions retained as descriptive sensitivity; no independent replication or uncertainty estimate.

original_absent_relative.interpretation: A different cue-relative response-score estimand; not corrected accuracy, a pure prior, or a causal attribution. H is invariant by construction.
